question: Where is the nearest gallery when heading toward Travelodge by Wyndham Fairfield/Napa Valley, Fairfield, CA from Steinhart Aquarium, CA?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Steinhart Aquarium%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Travelodge by Wyndham Fairfield/Napa Valley%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fairfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), total_route_distance AS ( SELECT ST_Distance(origin.geometry::geography, destination.geometry::geography) AS dist FROM origin, destination ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND (SELECT geometry FROM origin) IS NOT NULL -- Ensure origin exists AND (SELECT geometry FROM destination) IS NOT NULL -- Ensure destination exists -- Filter for galleries that are roughly "between" the origin and destination. -- The sum of distances from origin to gallery and gallery to destination should not be much greater -- than the direct distance from origin to destination (allowing for a 10% detour). AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM origin)::geography) + ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM destination)::geography) <= (SELECT dist FROM total_route_distance) * 1.1 -- Further ensure the gallery is "along the way" by checking it's closer to the origin than the destination. AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM origin)::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM destination)::geography) ORDER BY -- Order by distance from the origin to find the nearest one among the filtered results. p.geometry::geography <-> (SELECT geometry FROM origin)::geography LIMIT 1;
